annotations.title: Sign in to TaskLite with email and password

description: Connect this machine to an existing TaskLite account with email + password, or switch to a different account. Creates a personal API key named "claude-code" on that account and stores it, so the password is used once and never saved. Replaces the current connection if there is one. Prefer connect when the user already has a tl_ key.

password.description: Used once to mint an API key; never stored

name: login
